conventions: `$fill_bytes: N` stands for a JSON value whose compact serialization is exactly N bytes.
`elided` stands for a value pinned elsewhere (read budgets, tool results, event cursors).
Session frames scope_select, scope_release, assistance_ack and handoff_publish follow §3.7 [P].

cases.name: open_lease_held_by_session
cases.rule: W1: the service mints the window; only the session holds the lease

cases.name: renew_and_expiry
cases.rule: W2: valid while now < last renewal + ttl_ms; expiry acts as close

cases.name: foreign_lease
cases.rule: W2: a known window with another lease is refused and left unchanged

cases.name: open_limits
cases.rule: W1: at most 64 windows; label at most 128 bytes

cases.name: scope_select_in_memory_grant
cases.rule: W4 (U77): selects existing indexes only; nothing persisted

cases.name: scope_reselect_replaces
cases.rule: W4: a new grant atomically replaces the old one

cases.name: scope_release
cases.rule: W4b: release drops the grant; release is idempotent

cases.name: grant_revoked_on_service_restart
cases.rule: All W state is per instance; no stale grant is reused

cases.name: grant_revoked_on_session_close
cases.rule: Owner loss closes the window; process death expires it

cases.name: close_drops_state
cases.rule: W3: close drops the queue, handoffs and scope grant

cases.name: assistance_queue_count_bound
cases.rule: W6: at most 16 drafts; full is refused, never dropped

cases.name: assistance_queue_byte_bound
cases.rule: W6: draft <= 256 KiB, window queue <= 1 MiB (compact JSON bytes)

cases.name: drain_and_ack
cases.rule: W7: drain is non-destructive; ack removes; at most `limit` unacknowledged

cases.name: session_buffer_overflow_resync
cases.rule: Overflow drops the session buffer, emits one resync, re-drains

cases.name: cross_window_refused
cases.rule: Another window's lease or cursor never delivers its drafts

cases.name: handoff_publish_and_read
cases.rule: W8 + M12: published through the window session; reads do not consume

cases.name: handoff_limits
cases.rule: W8: ttl 1..=600000 ms, <= 64 KiB, <= 32 per window

cases.name: relay_refuses_lease_methods
cases.rule: Lease-bearing methods never cross the session control relay
